question_text: A person posted a defamatory article about a public official on a blog. The official wants to file a case under RA 10175 (Cybercrime Prevention Act). Which of the following is correct regarding cyber libel?

options.text: Cyber libel is not punishable if the article is true and published without malice.
The penalty for cyber libel is one degree higher than that for traditional libel under the Revised Penal Code.
Only the original author can be held liable, not the blog platform.
Cyber libel requires that the defamatory material be accessed by at least 100 people.
